evals.prompt: Technicians must complete jobs with no connectivity for hours, then sync safely when online again while dispatch may edit the same job remotely.
evals.expected_output: mobile-engineering activates local-first, durable mutations, explicit conflict semantics, restart recovery, and user-visible sync behavior.

evals.prompt: Use mobile-engineering to design this Flutter background upload flow.
evals.expected_output: The existing framework is preserved and lifecycle/background constraints are explicit.

evals.prompt: Make this desktop web dashboard responsive down to 360px browser width; it is not a mobile app.
evals.expected_output: mobile-engineering should not activate; ui-engineering owns the request.

evals.prompt: A mobile download says completed but disappears if Android kills the process before the next app launch.
evals.expected_output: mobile-engineering reasons about durable state, lifecycle boundaries, restart reconciliation, and appropriate regression evidence.

evals.prompt: Build a tiny authenticated mobile status viewer where every screen requires current server data and offline use is explicitly out of scope.
evals.expected_output: mobile-engineering does not invent an offline mutation queue or conflict engine.

evals.prompt: A mobile WebView needs camera access and sends bridge messages to native code.
evals.expected_output: mobile-engineering defines native/web ownership and reports a supporting security concern for bridge/device capability exposure.
